name: Four Seasons Hotel Florence
insider_take: This Renaissance palace turned luxury hotel sits along the Arno River, where Medici princes once strolled through the very gardens you'll enjoy today.
whats_special: The hotel occupies a 15th-century palazzo with the largest private garden in Florence's historic center. Many suites offer direct views of the Ponte Vecchio, and the property features original frescoes and period furnishings that transport you back to Florence's golden age.
pro_tip: Book a river-view suite on the second floor for the most spectacular unobstructed views of the Ponte Vecchio, especially magical at sunset when the bridge glows golden.
dont_miss: Il Palagio restaurant's Michelin-starred cuisine featuring locally-sourced Tuscan ingredients, and evening aperitivos in the Renaissance garden overlooking the Arno - it's the most exclusive riverside terrace in all of Florence.
pros: Prime historic location in the heart of Florence
Magnificent Renaissance palace architecture and decor
Beautiful private garden oasis in city center
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive positioning
Historic building constraints on room size variations
